title: One Tackler rule file (catalog/unblock-rules.d/<id>.json)
description: BH-7722 (UNB-0), BH-8418. One rule per file; a new rule is a new file. The loader (bin/lib/unblock/rules.sh ub_rules_load) refuses two files with one id and reads action.verb as action.name. The id need not equal the file stem: every lookup (bin/lib/unblock/override.sh uo_class_of) indexes by id. Every cite must be a key of _cites.json. Files whose name starts with _ are not rules. tests/unblock-rules-contract.bh-8418-test.sh validates every rule file against this schema.

id.description: The rule id, written to unblock_decisions.rule_id.

priority.description: Lower runs first; the first matching rule wins.

family.description: The collector family whose stall records the rule reads (queue, review, infra).

class.description: The staff_classes row the action counts against.

cites.description: Guideline codes; each must be a key of _cites.json.

kind.description: The stall record's kind, a non-empty list of kinds, or "*" for any kind (U12).

all.description: jq predicates over the stall record. An error or a null is unknown, and unknown never matches.

when.description: A jq predicate: the judge runs only when it is true.

verb.description: Read as name by the loader. A file sets name or verb, never both.

args.description: Each value is a jq path over the stall record, or a literal. The keys are the action's input in bin/lib/unblock/act.sh, whose header lists them per action.

action.description: card escalates (bin/lib/unblock/card.sh); every other action goes to ub_act (bin/lib/unblock/act.sh).

key.description: The record field paths (dotted for a nested field) hashed with the rule id into the decision key; the word id is the rule id. No timestamp, no counter.

never_auto.description: A proposal key glob (case-insensitive) to the class the decision carries when .proposal.key matches it (U12: spend).

after.description: What follows the act in act mode (U8: the alert severity and the watch window).

delegate_in_act.description: true: the class is delegated from day one in act mode (U8, the operator 6294290004 item 2).
